summaryZh: 神经发育演化与干细胞研究实验室研究人类特有细胞和分子特征在神经发育中受到扰动后，如何影响神经元功能与心理健康。它使用人类及非人灵长类干细胞模型和三维神经类器官，考察遗传性发育状况及微塑料等环境扰动。
researchQuestions: 人类特有的细胞和分子特征在神经发育中受扰动后如何影响心理健康？
methods: 人类及非人灵长类干细胞模型
三维干细胞来源神经类器官

evidence.quote: The lab uses stem cell models from human and nonhuman primate species to test hypotheses about the role of disruptions to human-specific cellular and molecular signatures during neurodevelopment and their potential impact on mental health. The lab focuses on using tridimensional stem cell-derived neural organoids to study the physiological behavior of human neurons in neurodevelopmental conditions that have a genetic (ex. Autism Spectrum Disorder) or after exposure to environmental perturbation (ex. exposure to micro-plastics).

Neurodevelopmental Evolution and Stem Cell Research Laboratory The Neurodevelopmental Evolution and Stem Cell Research Laboratory is located on the third floor of the Social Sciences Research Building.
